# Third-party notices

Generated from Cargo.lock and the installed frontend lockfile by node scripts/notices.mjs. Includes build/test dependencies as well as runtime components. Original NavarchNet code remains Apache-2.0; these dependencies retain the licenses recorded in components.json. Full available upstream license/NOTICE texts are preserved in ecosystem/package-version directories. Components without a top-level notice file retain their SPDX metadata and source reference; inspect upstream sources before adding distribution obligations. Do not edit generated notices.
